tools_problematic.problem: It copied only files physically below the project directory and ignored explicit MSBuild-linked items outside that tree.
tools_problematic.evidence: The bootstrap mapped only four files, while TouchKeyboardTextInput.csproj links App.xaml, MainPage.xaml, Styles.xaml, shared code, scenario XAML, and assets through Include/Link entries.

tools_problematic.problem: The installed standalone winapp CLI has no build command.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 15: 'build was not matched' and the CLI listed run/package/sign but no build command.

tools_problematic.problem: For 0xc000027b with no event 1026, its hint asserted a likely unsupported projection instead of prioritizing startup XAML/resource activation.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turns 16-17: managedType and message were empty, but the hint directed the agent toward unsupported APIs; subsequent retries guessed at window chrome and resources.

tool_limitations.limitation: Only event 1000 was available for the crash, so there was no managed exception type, message, or stack frame.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: For 0xc000027b in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll without event 1026, direct the agent to a resource-preserving XAML isolation sequence and explicitly say the code is not evidence for deferral.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build guidance
doc_errors.correct: Use dotnet build; the standalone winapp CLI is used for packaged launch, not compilation.

doc_errors.wrong: Treat 0xc000027b primarily as a legacy projection/activation incompatibility and defer unsupported APIs.
doc_errors.correct: When Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll is the faulting module and event 1026 is absent, first inspect startup XAML, merged dictionaries, resource keys, x:Class, and control properties; defer only with evidence of an invoked unsupported API.

special_apis.special_handling: Resolve linked Compile, ApplicationDefinition, Page, Content, EmbeddedResource, and PRIResource items to their source paths and copy them to their Link paths before namespace rewriting and mapping.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent launched the bootstrap and Test-Path in parallel, so the check raced artifact creation.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent reran Test-Path after the bootstrap completed and received True.

errors_encountered.error: winapp build: required command was not provided; 'build' was not matched.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The migration skill documented a command absent from the installed winapp CLI.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent switched to dotnet build.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch reported no build output under bin\x64\Debug.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent started build and launch concurrently; launch inspected output before the build completed.
errors_encountered.fix: Later launches occurred after an x64 build produced the expected layout.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The managed cause was not captured. The migration had manually reconstructed linked XAML/resources, and the final target removed Styles.xaml while startup pages still depended on keyed resources, leaving an inconsistent startup resource graph.
errors_encountered.fix: Not resolved in the trial. Preserve linked dictionaries and isolate startup XAML without deleting resource providers.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched obj output and sibling SharedContent, then manually rebuilt MainPage, both scenario pages, Styles, and shell wiring.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: About 10 turns from source discovery through the first build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap did not resolve the UWP csproj's external Include/Link items, so its mapping falsely contained only four files.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent used generated obj XAML and shared folders as references and recreated missing target files by hand.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to copy evaluated linked project items to their Link paths before inventory.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent retried the same native startup crash after removing window chrome, removing a merged dictionary, deleting Styles.xaml, and replacing resource references.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: At least three failed smoke launches across roughly 12 turns.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No managed stack was available and the supplied 0xc000027b hint pointed toward unsupported projections rather than XAML/resource activation.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Unresolved; the final validator still reported the same startup crash.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Correct the launch hint and startup pattern with a resource-preserving blank-page/bisection sequence.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Self-check and launch commands raced prerequisite commands and returned False/unavailable.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The agent parallelized dependent commands despite the skill's ordered bootstrap and build-launch loop.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: It reran each command after its prerequisite completed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: No new skill content; the existing ordered steps were already explicit.

missing_tooling.need: Automatic migration inventory for MSBuild-linked source and resource items.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The manual search through generated obj files and reconstruction of the shared shell, pages, styles, code, and assets.

env_issues.issue: The installed winapp CLI does not expose a build subcommand.
env_issues.workaround: Use dotnet build for compilation and Test-AppLaunch.ps1 for packaged launch.
